mmr.name: Mayor's Management Report FY2025, indicator definitions (NYPD p. 33-34, FDNY p. 44-45)

definitions.police: Critical police calls: NYPD’s highest-priority calls for crimes in progress, such as shots fired, a robbery or an assault with a weapon. Typical (median) minutes from when NYPD dispatch logs the call to when officers report arriving; calls with no arrival time are left out. Source: NYPD Calls for Service, NYC Open Data; “critical” as defined in the Mayor’s Management Report.
definitions.ems: Life-threatening calls: medical emergencies FDNY classifies as life-threatening, such as cardiac arrest, choking or major trauma. Typical (median) minutes from when FDNY creates the incident to when the first ambulance arrives; calls without a valid time are left out. Source: FDNY EMS Incident Dispatch Data, NYC Open Data; “life-threatening” as defined in the Mayor’s Management Report.
definitions.clocks: Both clocks start after the 911 call has been answered and passed to dispatch, which takes about 2½ minutes on average (Mayor’s Management Report), so neither is the caller’s full wait.
definitions.pct116: The 116th Precinct was created in December 2024 from parts of the 105th and 113th. 2019 police calls are placed by their location within today’s boundaries. Ambulance records don’t separate the 116th, so its ambulance figure is shown only for the three precincts combined, and the 105th and 113th ambulance figures cover their old areas.
definitions.small: small: true when fewer than 200 calls in the year.

police_2019_116_split.method: point-in-polygon on latitude/longitude vs build/geo/precincts_full.geojson; calls just outside all three outlines (boundary-street midblocks) go to the nearest of the three if within 1,000 ft, otherwise keep NYPD's 105/113 code

notes.ems_116: FDNY's EMS data has no coordinates and codes almost no incidents to the 116th (see ems_116_by_month_2025), so 105th and 113th EMS figures cover their old, pre-116 areas in both years and the 116th has no EMS figure of its own. Use the 105+113+116 group for EMS.
